observations: Large black plastic water tank with horizontal ribbed construction.
Brand 'GEPEE' and 'CAPTECH' logo visible on the side in photo 0.
The tank shows significant surface wear, dirt, and staining on the lower portion.
A small drain plug is visible at the bottom in all photos.
The tank is positioned outdoors on a paved surface with other tanks and vehicles in the background.

claims.evidence: The brand 'GEPEE' is visible in photo 0, but the material is not explicitly stated as rubber or plastic.
The capacity is not clearly legible on the tank in the provided photos.
No manufacturer's seal or FDA/food-grade markings are visible in the photos.

claims.claim: used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The tank may be made of low-density polyethylene (LDPE) rather than high-density polyethylene (HDPE), which is more common for this capacity and has a shorter lifespan.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's stamped identification plate on the side or bottom of the tank.

risks.risk: The tank may have hidden structural cracks or internal corrosion not visible from the outside.
risks.proof: A video showing a pressure test or a close-up inspection of the welds and seams.
risks.if_unproven: priced as requiring a full structural inspection

risks.risk: The capacity may be significantly lower than 4000 liters.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the stamped capacity marking on the side of the tank.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Clear photo of the stamped capacity marking on the side of the tank.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate showing the model and material grade.
Video showing the tank being filled with water to confirm the material and integrity.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
